parser_input.description: returns a token length and writes a token type through an out-parameter; the token type distinguishes illegal/error tokens

buffer_copy.description: copies a number of bytes from a source pointer to a destination buffer

dequoter.description: removes quoting/escaping from a token string; requires a valid quoted token and may assert on illegal input

aborting_assert.description: stops execution when its condition is false, so the dequoter's precondition must be satisfied
